details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/alert-triage.yml:131-150 (step "Diagnose groups" env) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The "Diagnose groups" step sets only ALERT_TRIAGE_MODEL, CODEX_VERSION and SUPPORT_INSTRUCTIONS_FILE and does not pass OPENROUTER_API_KEY. The codex fallback needs that key: scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:504 fails without it. tests/test_alert_triage_route.py::test_only_the_prepare_step_gets_the_pat asserts `"secrets." not in diagnose`, which locks the omission in.
  WHY: AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK_POLICY=always is set and the broker refuses alert-triage.yml until the Worker is redeployed, so every ALERT_TRIAGE call falls back to codex and fails. Every group then escalates as engine_failed and sends a Telegram message, and no alert is ever classified. All five reviewers rated this BLOCKER.
- agents.md:5612 (`<!-- TREE:START id=workflows -->` block) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The auto-generated workflow tree was not regenerated. `.github/workflows/alert-triage.yml` is missing between alert-inbox-intake.yml and audit_consumer_drift.yml.
  WHY: `quick / static-checks` on head 1f8f83f2 fails `make generate-check` with `FAIL: agents.md is out of date; run make generate`, which blocks merge. Rated BLOCKER.
- agents.md:~5662-5669 (`<!-- TREE:START id=workflows -->` block) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: This PR adds the new workflow file but not the matching line in the auto-generated workflow inventory, which skips `.github/workflows/alert-triage.yml`.
  WHY: `make generate-check` (tools/repo_tree/update_repo_tree.py --check) fails with `##[error]FAIL: agents.md is out of date; run make generate` on PR head 1f8f83f2. This is a failing required check. Rated BLOCKER. It is the same root cause as the entry above but cites a non-overlapping line range, so it is not merged.
- scripts/alert_triage.py:433-486 (prepare(), `if groups:` gating list_open_items; tracking built at 477-486) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Open ai:workflow-heal issues and ai:alert-self-fix PRs are listed only when unprocessed alert groups exist, and those lists are the only input to the overdue checks (ALERT_TRIAGE_ISSUE_ESCALATE_HOURS, ALERT_TRIAGE_PR_ESCALATE_HOURS).
  WHY: Once the inbox is drained, which is the steady state, hourly runs make no list calls, so an overdue issue (>24h) or PR (>6h) is not escalated until an unrelated alert arrives. This contradicts the plan and issue item 6. All rated MAJOR.
- scripts/alert_triage.py:387-390 (collect_evidence() job-log GET) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `runner(["api", f"repos/{repo}/actions/jobs/{int(job['id'])}/logs"])` omits `--allow-escape-sequences`, which every other Actions-log reader passes (workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1842-1848, workflow_failure_heal_evidence.sh:78-80, evidence_broker.py:597, check_triage_resolution.py:873).
  WHY: Job logs carry ANSI colour codes, so gh refuses the body. The read returns "(evidence unavailable: log_read_failed)" and still spends evidence-budget GETs, which pushes diagnoses toward unsure and adds Telegram escalations. All rated MAJOR.
- scripts/alert_triage.py:888-893 (build_self_fix_body(), `json.dumps(...)[:DIAGNOSIS_MAX_BYTES]`) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: After clearing proposed_fix and evidence, a diagnosis can still exceed 16384 bytes (summary, files, decisions). The code then slices the serialised JSON mid-value and produces invalid JSON.
  WHY: _at_self_fix_dispatch POSTs unparseable `inputs.diagnosis` to alert-self-fix.yml, and the attempt still counts toward the 2-in-7-days cap. test_build_self_fix_body_caps_the_diagnosis checks only length. Severity disagreement: minimax rated BLOCKER, the other four rated MAJOR; HIGHEST used. Reviewers also disagree on whether the char-vs-byte slice matters: minimax and glm say the slice counts characters not bytes, while claude says json.dumps defaults to ensure_ascii, so characters equal bytes.
- scripts/alert_triage.py:515-531 (_write_group_input(), `defang(record["message"])`) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Captured alert messages reach the model prompt without secret redaction. defang() only rewrites UNTRUSTED fence markers, and the capture path (scripts/alert_inbox_capture.sh:195-203, 251-257) stores raw text.
  WHY: Credentials embedded in alert text are sent to the ALERT_TRIAGE prompt verbatim and persist in the prompt artefact. glm additionally claims collect_evidence (379-388) skips the intake's `heal.py redact-stream` step. claude listed message redaction only as a hardening suggestion. Rated MAJOR by all four.
- scripts/alert_triage.py:410-420, 793-815 (apply() done markers written regardless of dry_run; prepare() filters done/) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: ALERT_TRIAGE_DRY_RUN suppresses dispatch and Telegram but not record consumption. Done markers are written and pushed in dry run, and later runs filter those records out.
  WHY: ALERT_TRIAGE_DRY_RUN defaults to 'true' (alert-triage.yml line 60), so alerts captured during the dry-run rollout window are drained in max_alerts chunks and are never dispatched once the workflow goes live. Rated MAJOR. claude reviewed this and did not adopt it as a finding (documented behaviour, needed for the window to advance).
- scripts/alert_triage.py:800-821 + scripts/alert_triage_route.sh:360-394 (done markers and ledger attempts pushed before the dispatch loop) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Records are durably marked done, and dispatch attempts are recorded in the ledger, before the external dispatch or escalation is attempted. No durable pending-dispatch state exists.
  WHY: If the job crashes or is cancelled after the push but before dispatch, the alert is filtered out as done on every later run and is never dispatched or escalated. glm adds that the false attempt consumes the 2-in-7-days cap. Rated MAJOR. claude reviewed this and did not adopt it (documented at-most-once ordering).
- scripts/alert_triage.py:822-832 + scripts/alert_triage_route.sh:396-400 (apply() escalated_items flag written before the `_at_send` Telegram send) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: An overdue issue or PR is flagged in ledger/escalated_items.json and committed before Telegram delivery succeeds, and a failed send does not clear the flag.
  WHY: decide() skips flagged items (`if item_id in flagged: continue`), so a single transient send failure means the item is never escalated. All rated NIT.
- scripts/alert_triage.py:838-846 (apply() escalated_items flag) + scripts/alert_triage_route.sh _at_send (~255-275) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The escalation flag is committed before the send, and a failed send leaves the flag set with no retry.
  WHY: An overdue item whose single Telegram send fails is never escalated again, because decide() drops it at line 758. Rated NIT. Same root cause as the entry above, but the line range is more than 5 lines away, so it is not merged.
- .github/workflows/alert-triage.yml (env block, `AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK_POLICY: 'always'` and `CLAUDE_POOL_CAPACITY_WAIT_ENABLED: 'false'`) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: With fallback policy always and the broker not allowlisting alert-triage.yml, every call goes to codex unconditionally, so the declared capability ("Claude, codex fallback") diverges from the effective one ("codex-only, broken until OPENROUTER_API_KEY is added").
  WHY: The fallback path is broken end-to-end on day one, operators cannot tell "engine failed" from "no records" without reading logs, and every failed group sends a Telegram message. Rated MAJOR.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: no hunk passes OPENROUTER_API_KEY to the diagnose step; scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:504 requires it; test_only_the_prepare_step_gets_the_pat locks `"secrets." not in diagnose`; the role is registered in .github/ai/claude_engine.json, scripts/claude_engine.py and tests/test_claude_engine.py, but the fallback cannot run; established pattern is .github/workflows/cs_investigate.yml:269
- requirement: The agents.md repo-tree (auto-generated) must include the new workflow; agents.md is in the expected-files list and CI requires `make generate-check` to pass.

- requirement: "collects evidence through `scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.sh` and the bounded log fetch in `scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh`, capped by `ALERT_TRIAGE_MAX_EVIDENCE_GETS` (default 5)"
  expected_change_site: scripts/alert_triage.py collect_evidence() (lines 362-393) / evidence-collection step of prepare()
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: no changed file references workflow_failure_heal_evidence.sh; collect_evidence() reimplements the jobs-list and log GETs directly and reuses only heal.select_evidence_jobs and heal.filter_log; it diverged from the intake fetch by dropping --allow-escape-sequences; the budget cap itself is implemented
